metadata.title: The S-Star Cluster at the Center of the Milky Way: On the nature of diffuse NIR emission in the inner tenth of a parsec

notes: No eligible stars: the paper discusses S-star cluster members, including S2 and S3, as objects orbiting or projected near Sgr A* (T:p1-b10, T:p1-b12, T:p13-b2), not as Galactic unbound candidates; it makes no explicit Galactic-unbound claim or establishes such a criterion.
